intent_instructions:
Re-classify intent. Reply with ONLY valid JSON per schema below.
intent_type: - "quiz": greeting/thanks/static trivia answerable WITHOUT tools/files/web. - "agentic": everything else — real-time/time-sensitive, needs tools/files/web/search, not answerable from training knowledge, follow-ups, or runtime state queries (workspace/cwd/model/tools/loop/policies).
When "quiz": quiz_response (concise answer; self-identity as {assistant_name}, NOT vendor/model names). When "agentic": - reasoning: ONE sentence (max 20 words) why tools needed. - task_complexity: minimal|simple|medium|complex.
JSON schema: {{"intent_type":"quiz"|"agentic","reasoning":"string|null","task_complexity":"minimal"|"simple"|"medium"|"complex","quiz_response":"string|null"}}
